Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 332)

Quick AI

  • Quick AI (Cmd+J, or the sparkles toolbar button) chats with your own Claude, Codex or Cursor login.
  • Two tabs: Chat (one chat in a folder you pick) and Workspace (one chat per workspace, with its terminal, browser, folder and branch as context).
  • Type / for commands and skills, $ for Codex skills, @ to attach context.
  • Start a message with ! to send a command to the AI exactly as you typed it. The input turns pink.
  • While the AI replies, press Return to queue your next message. Queued messages go out one by one; Stop puts them back in the input.
  • Up arrow brings back earlier messages. Saved chats are in History.
  • Tool rows open to show the full command and result. Your account and plan show in the footer.

Also new

  • New icon picker with every SF Symbol and emoji. Cmd+P: Change active tab icon…
  • Tooltips show hotkeys, for example New chat (⌘N).
  • The workspace hover card shows the full workspace name and wraps long tab names.
  • A Claude chat from a deleted worktree resumes from the repo folder.
  • Dock badge for unread notifications. Drag pinned tabs to reorder them.
  • Cmd+P Browser category opens pages from your browser history. On/off settings have a switch in Cmd+P.
  • Markdown preview draws Mermaid diagrams. Updates are checked every hour.
